_: Plates out of use until the user repaints them (Downloads/RidonculousRace-frames/edit/<src>/, prompt.txt there). tools/rr-vp-repaints.py notices a repaint in done/ (its file no longer matches sha256 below), makes it a plate and switches it on (js/vp-rr-ep/repainted.js). A NEW job ("new": true) is a view or a cut-out that does not exist yet: it switches on when a file of that name appears in done/<src>/ (a cut-out: done/<src>/cutout/), and plates.js uses a stand-in until then.
